Our ops team just completed a critical security hotfix deployment for Issue #99 (the CVE-2024-9911 JWT vulnerability). We have the full mission brief saved at workspace/ops/missions/mission_brief_99.txt.

I need you to produce three operational documents for this mission, saved as:
- `task_start.txt` — the mission kickoff record
- `status_update.txt` — the mid-mission progress board (at the PARTIAL state, 1h 30m elapsed)
- `task_close.txt` — the mission closure record

All formatting must strictly follow our internal Mission Control standard (described in SKILL.md). The ops team is very particular about the exact format — wrong separators, missing fields, or wrong emoji will cause the documents to be rejected by our automated validator.
